title: Rural Oral Health Access | Cascade Health Foundation
text:
Rural Oral Health Access Grant 2027.
Funder: Cascade Health Foundation.
Summary: Two-year grants for nonprofits that bring preventive dental care to rural Washington communities.
Awards: up to $75,000 per year.
Deadline: Applications due March 3, 2027.
Eligibility: 501(c)(3) nonprofits serving rural Washington counties.
How to apply: complete the online application and attach your program budget.
